docs/REMIT-HANDOVER.md 1.1 — two like transactions of one file, written out again, the second with a UETR
step 1 — the same transaction of the same file, whatever else differs
step 1 — another position of the same file is another transaction
step 2 — a recognition stands, also after what it was recognised by is gone from the picture
step 3 — the same UETR: the same payment, or a reference used twice
step 3 — a first settlement without content: its UETR is never "reused" for content
step 4 — with a UETR in hand, only a settlement without one can be the twin
step 4 — the oldest free twin, by time and then by id
step 4 — undated: refused each time, never recorded; dated on one side only is no twin
step 4 — no content, no key: nothing is a twin
letter case and white space tell nothing apart
another organisation's ledger is its own

this message's payment is already settlement PAY-VEC-C-TWIN-1 — the same identifiers, the same value date and the same content, in another message. Nothing was accepted; read its state with GET /v1/settlements/PAY-VEC-C-TWIN-1 instead of sending it again. If it is meant as another payment, give it a reference of its own — another instruction or end-to-end identifier

this payment cannot be told from settlement PAY-VEC-C-UNDATED-1: the same identifiers and the same content, and the message states no value date to tell two payments apart. Nothing was accepted. If it is that payment, read its state with GET /v1/settlements/PAY-VEC-C-UNDATED-1; if it is another one, give it a reference of its own — another instruction or end-to-end identifier
